title: Yeah! Even though it was wet outside, I still had lots of fun.
scene: 下雨还跑出去玩，回来爸爸数落。

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You actually went outside in the rain?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Yeah! Even though it was wet outside, I still had lots of fun.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Did you get completely soaked out there?

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Just my feet got wet. The puddles were totally worth it.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You are going to catch a cold like that.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But I feel totally fine. Can I go out again tomorrow?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Maybe you can, if it's not pouring rain.
